principles: Use the strongest practical source for each feature rather than one provider for everything.
Prefer first-party/official sources for canonical schedules, identities and final results.
Prefer specialist structured sources for granular game/PBP/player metrics when they expose the required fields reliably.
Use a fallback only when explicitly allowed for that feature.
Never replace missing critical values with estimates or arbitrary substitutions.
Store provenance and preserve the source hierarchy in audits.

starting_pitchers.rule: Only use a starter for a pregame prediction when the starter is confirmed by a game-day/pre-first-pitch source. Do not substitute the postgame actual starter into a historical pregame feature row.

pitch_level_and_pitcher_detail.rule: Use only records whose publication/event timestamp is not later than the prediction cutoff for pregame features.

advanced_batting_pitching_reference.rule: Historical reference metrics must respect the prediction cutoff; no season-final values may leak into earlier games.

weather.primary: Open-Meteo historical archive / forecast snapshot when available
weather.rule: Never synthesize missing weather. Historical backtests may only consume archived observations available for the target date.
